title: Europa Society at UCC | County Pairings
description: A growing, student-built atlas that begins with Ireland's official county-country pairings and develops carefully sourced local-to-local research.

organisation.name: Europa Society at University College Cork

scope.irishCountySet: The 26 traditional counties in the Republic of Ireland
scope.officialLayer: An Irish county and the European country assigned through Ireland's 2026 EU County Pairings initiative
scope.researchLayer: A specific overseas region, city, department, county-equivalent or other appropriate locality selected and researched by participating students

editorialPrinciples: Begin with evidence rather than a preferred story.
Keep the official county-country pairing separate from the student-selected local research focus.
Label facts, interpretations, research leads and open questions distinctly.
Use claim-level sources, favouring primary and institutional sources.
Publish student names, quotations, images and work only with recorded permission.
Show similarities and differences without reducing either place to stereotypes.
Treat each page as a living record with visible review information.

verified.label: Verified
verified.meaning: The claim is supported by a reviewed source listed in the record.

under-review.label: Under review
under-review.meaning: Material has been submitted but has not completed editorial review.

research-lead.label: Research lead
research-lead.meaning: A promising question or connection that must not yet be presented as established fact.

unassigned.label: Not yet assigned
unassigned.meaning: No value has been chosen or approved for this field.

not-yet-recorded.label: Not yet recorded
not-yet-recorded.meaning: The atlas has not yet added or verified this information; it does not mean that no pairing exists.
